thread:
kyle: Heads-up — planning a config-only deploy in 10m for routing + batching tweaks on /generate and /chat. Canary 5% initially, target rollout 5% -> 25% -> 100% if green. Main changes: rate-floor 5rps/customer, per-route timeout 600ms->450ms, batching max_wait 5ms->8ms. Pin /generate to model variant redwood-2.3-quant during rollout. @maya @zara please watch latency and error budgets.

maya: ack. I'll be watching p50/p95 and 5xx. Abort criteria: p50 > 350ms or errors +2% vs baseline.

zara: quick note — recent small canaries didn't catch regional tail spikes. Can we extend the canary window to 60m instead of 30m? 5% seems fine, just longer watch.

kyle: good call, switching canary duration to 60m. will update deploybot.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued by kyle. Type: config-only. Canary=5%, duration=60m, plan=5%->25%->100%. Affected routes: /generate, /chat. Changes: rate_floor=5, timeout_ms=450, batch_max_wait_ms=8. Rollout id cfg-deploy-1778900123. Starting canary in 8m.

eli: Adding automatic rollback thresholds to the plan: p95 increase > 200ms vs baseline OR 5xx rate > 2x baseline -> auto rollback. Also add soft fail: if CPU on gpu-pool > 85% for 5m, throttle ramp.

ops-bot: Noted. Will notify on threshold breaches and post links to metric dashboards.

deploy-bot: Canary started. cfg-deploy-1778900123 -> canary group (5%). Snapshot link: https://dash/internal/metrics/cfg-deploy-1778900123

deploy-bot: Canary metrics @ +15m: p50=230ms (baseline 220), p95=520ms (baseline 490), error_rate +0.4%, cpu_pool avg=65%. No rollback triggered.

maya: looks acceptable so far. continuing to monitor — call rollback if p95 > 600ms or errors > 1.5%.

kyle: after 45m canary looks stable on regional dashboards. proceeding to ramp to 25% now.

deploy-bot: Ramp to 25% initiated. ETA for completion ~3m.

deploy-bot: Ramp complete. Metrics after ramp: p50=240ms, p95=580ms, error_rate +0.8%, cpu_pool=72%. Within configured thresholds.

zara: seeing a small tail bump in eu-west at ~10:12 UTC (p95 up to 610ms for 6m). Recommend holding at 25% for additional 30m and not proceeding to full ramp until we confirm stability.

kyle: sg, hold at 25%. If it persists past the extra 30m we roll back and revert pin.

maya: noted. I'll watch EU more closely and post any anomalies.

deploy-bot: Hold applied. Will pause automatic ramp to 100% until manual resume.

eli: FYI — if we rollback we should also unpin redwood-2.3-quant and allow fallback to redwood-2.3-fp16 to reduce memory pressure.

kyle: agreed. Will prepare rollback note and send postmortem template if needed. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
